description: A polished local Simon-style memory arcade. Watch the progressive colour pattern, repeat it with tactile audio-visual feedback, and master all three difficulty lanes without a wallet or GAS payment. The GameFi lane stays disabled until the deployed testnet reward pool is funded and the complete settlement flow is revalidated.
description_zh: 精心打磨的本地 Simon 风格记忆街机。观察逐步增长的颜色序列，通过清晰的视听反馈按顺序复现，并挑战三档难度；无需钱包或 GAS。测试网奖励池完成注资且完整结算流程重新验证前，GameFi 通道保持关闭。
name: Color Clash

operation_panel.subtitle: Choose a difficulty, watch each progressive pattern, and repeat it locally. Wallet-funded GameFi remains unavailable while the testnet reward pool is empty.

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: The deployed oracle wiring is reachable, but no wallet-funded oracle path is advertised until the empty reward pool is funded and an end-to-end settlement succeeds.

tee.description: Local play uses Web-Crypto randomness. TEE settlement remains a gated future lane while production readiness is revalidated.
